summary: Iteration 5: tested favicon/manifest/ads.txt, Consent Mode v2 + EU cookie banner, /showcases countdown hub, About/Contact/Privacy pages, POST /api/contact (validation, persistence, 5/hr rate limit) and a regression smoke test. Everything requested works: 13/13 backend pytest checks passed and all frontend flows passed.

minor.issue: The rate-limit IP comes from the first X-Forwarded-For value, which the client controls. A client can set a different XFF on each request to get past the 5/hour limit (confirmed: a custom XFF value was stored as the ip). Use the last trusted proxy hop or request.client.host instead.
The count-then-insert rate-limit check is not atomic, so parallel bursts can go slightly over 5. Low impact.

issues: The featured 'Next up' event also appears as the first list row, so it shows twice. Consider list.slice(1).

action_items: (Minor) Make the contact rate limit resistant to a spoofed X-Forwarded-For
(Optional) Avoid showing the featured showcase twice
critical_code_review_comments: index.html: two consent 'default' calls (EEA-region denied, then global granted). This is the Google-documented pattern and the region-specific one wins. Both appear in dataLayer before adsbygoogle.js. OK.

index.html sets window.adsbygoogle.requestNonPersonalizedAds=1 for a stored 'denied'. After adsbygoogle.js loads, the property reads undefined. Consent Mode 'update denied' already handles non-personalised ads, so the impact is low.
Showcases.jsx: the upcoming useMemo has an empty dependency list, so an event that passes while the page stays open won't drop off until reload. Minor.
CookieConsent decides Europe from the browser timezone only, so EU users with non-Europe timezones won't see the banner. Consent Mode region defaults still deny for them. Acceptable.
seed_data_creation: None. All TEST_ contact docs and the main agent's t@x.com doc were deleted; contact_messages is now empty.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: Europe/Berlin timezone shows the banner, accept sets gr_consent=granted, decline sets denied, the banner stays hidden on reload, and footer-cookie-settings and privacy-cookie-settings-btn reopen it. America/New_York shows no banner. Showcases: featured countdown ticks, 8 rows, filters correct (nintendo 1, playstation 1, xbox 2, multi 4), 5 past links to YouTube searches. Footer links go to About/Contact/Privacy with scrollY=0. Contact UI submit shows contact-success. Smoke: home, /game/:slug and /ai-guide load. Rate-limit test uses fake XFF IPs 10.99.x.y.
